summary: Becker County, MN lookout listed as Pickerel and removed; a county compilation says it was formerly noted as Pickerel and now lists a Juggler Lake tower with footings left. Link unconfirmed.

corrections.why: Tower removed is a status, not an agency. No source read names an agency for the Pickerel name.

The Becker County compilation lists a Juggler Lake tower and says it was formerly noted as Pickerel. The A-Z list repeats that entry but is not an independent source for the link, so the name is recorded as a possible alias.

notes_for_editor: The Becker County PDF and the A-Z list (source 4) carry the same Juggler Lake entry worded Formerly Pickerel; no independent source ties the two names. The brief's agency field held a status and was corrected. No build date, height, staffing or current site description found. Check whether a Juggler Lake record exists before merging. Access unknown. The Central Lookouts photo already in the record was not re-listed.
